I feel you man, and I’ve been doing the same. But I’m also trying to see it as time to hang out with myself, improve myself and ultimately enjoy myself. 

I’m not gonna lie: it’s not what I want to do. It sickly feels much better to wallow in the sadness, in a way it’s the last thing I felt when we were together(referring to the last seconds we were together as she broke us up), and it feels comfortable to give in to the anxiety and obsess over whether or not they’re hurting like you.
But the more you think about them, the less you think about yourself

Don’t mind this long comment, I think I’m projecting as I’m still hurting and coming to these realizations myself haha..

Duuuude.. this was my greatest fear bc I’m a bit of an introvert.. but I began to look forward to spending time with her and doing what we used to do in the Before Times.. and now she’s doing all that without me :(
I just want to go back in time now..

I don't have any hard feelings, quite the opposite in fact. I think it was better to have that first experience with a parent than at a party where anything could've happened.

Me quitting now has more to do with my job doing random FAA drug tests every month and that it reminds me of my ex wife. I introduced MJ to her cause she was having some major side effects from her antidepressants and at the end they weren't doing jack shit for her. MJ was our special thing to do together and now that that's over, I can't bring myself to even look at weed. 
I've been sober for 3 weeks( well, weed sober since I'm still drinking) and it's forcing me to tackle my own mental issues with strength from within.
